challenge.method: Compare the opening pipeline abstraction with the actual Spitbol translator, the assembler, the proposed replacement, and the earlier abstract.
challenge.results: The running translator emitted 370 assembler for IBM’s F assembler to complete the machine-code path. Boom describes the direct object-module replacement as work in progress.

limitations: The claim describes the separate-stage pipeline. Direct machine-code emission by the then-running Janus translator would exceed the statement.
